plugin.description: Browse your Instagram following feed, profiles, posts, and comments in Flare.
login.browser.description: Complete sign-in in the Instagram page opened by Flare.
login.importCookies.description: Paste the Cookie header from your own signed-in Instagram session. Treat it like a password.
error.authenticationRequired: Instagram requires verification. Sign in again through Flare and complete any checks on the Instagram page.
error.rateLimited: Instagram is limiting requests. Try again after the cooldown.
error.invalidCookies: Enter a Cookie header containing a valid sessionid and ds_user_id.
error.notFound: This Instagram profile or post is unavailable.
error.remote: Instagram could not complete the request.
error.unsupported: This Instagram operation is unavailable in Flare.
error.network: Flare could not connect to Instagram.
